title: Product Launch Email
description: Write a professional product launch email
prompt:
Write a professional email announcing the launch of a new AI-powered task management app called 'FlowMaster' to existing customers. The email should:
1. Be engaging and concise (under 200 words)
2. Highlight 3 key features: AI task prioritization, smart scheduling, team collaboration
3. Include a clear call-to-action
4. Maintain a friendly yet professional tone

evaluation_criteria.description: Effectively communicates value and drives action
